The Cobham Clinic Network was founded in 1979 as a small private practice; it has since added telehealth as a complement to its three consulting rooms. Membership is capped. Most members are referred by existing members. The same physicians have practised in the network for decades.

Creative.tagline: A telehealth practice for after the day is done.
Creative.brandDescription: The After-Hours Co is a creative-led telehealth practice operating exclusively in evening and weekend hours, with clinicians who work the evening shift by choice.
Creative.scope:
The After-Hours Co works across:
• Telehealth consultations between 6pm and midnight, weekdays and weekends
• Clinicians who work evening shifts by choice and tenure
• Plain published per-session pricing
• Same-evening medication coordination with pharmacies
• Annual practice-update letter to past patients
Creative.mission: To run a telehealth practice for the hours when most clinics are closed.
Creative.vision: A practice whose third-year evening patients refer their colleagues to the same evening clinicians.
coreValues: Warm — the practice is open when patients need it.
Specific — every hour of operation is documented and published.
Considered — clinicians work the evening shift by choice.
Direct — the operating-hours position is the marketing.
Creative.brandNameRationale: After-Hours is the real medical-trade term for the time outside standard clinic hours, when most primary-care offices are closed but illness and injury continue. The definite article + Co suffix follows the considered-creative trade-name school. The brand stakes a clear position around when it operates rather than what it operates.
Creative.manifesto: Most telehealth practices operate during business hours and close at 5pm — the same hours when patients are at work. We started The After-Hours Co for the actual time when patients need care — the evenings, the weekends, the moments when the regular doctor isn't answering. The clinicians work the evening shift by choice. The practice is open when other practices are closed.
Creative.industrySummary: Telehealth has not solved the after-hours care access problem — most telehealth practices operate during business hours. There is real space for a creative-led practice that operates exclusively in evening and weekend hours with clinicians who choose that schedule.
Creative.competitorLandscape: K Health (khealth.com) plays the broader telehealth peer slot. Doctor on Demand (doctorondemand.com) holds the 24/7 telehealth peer position. Teladoc (teladoc.com) sits in the broad-availability peer reference. We sit further out — evening and weekend hours only, clinicians who choose the evening shift.
Creative.positioningStatement: The After-Hours Co is a telehealth practice operating exclusively in evening and weekend hours with clinicians who work the evening shift by choice.
Creative.positioningRationale: The brand competes on the time of operation. Every consultation is in the evening or weekend; clinicians are not pulled from daytime shifts.

targetAudience.primary: Working adults who experience illness or injury outside business hours and want a practice operating when they're available.
behaviors: Work standard daytime hours and find primary care inaccessible.
Need care for illness or injury that arises in the evening or weekend.
Want a practice open when they're actually free.
Pay session fees directly.
motivations: Want a practice that operates after work hours.
Want clinicians who work the evening shift by choice.
Want plain pricing for evening visits.

dos: Publish operating hours prominently on the home page.
Reference 'evening' and 'weekend' in marketing material.
Sign post-visit summaries by the clinician's name and shift.
Confirm bookings in one evening-friendly line.

messagingPillars.name: Evening and weekend only
messagingPillars.description: The practice operates 6pm-midnight weekdays and Saturday-Sunday all day. There are no daytime appointments.

messagingPillars.name: Evening-shift clinicians
messagingPillars.description: The practice's clinicians work the evening shift by choice and have done so for at least three years. They are not pulled from daytime rotations.

messagingPillars.name: Same-evening pharmacy coordination
messagingPillars.description: Prescriptions and refills are coordinated with the patient's pharmacy the same evening. The patient does not wait until the next business day.

Creative.logoDirection: A wordmark — The After-Hours Co set in a quiet display serif with a small illustration of a lamp shining in a window beside it. The mark feels printed on a heritage night-clinic sign.

colorPalette.name: Night

colorPalette.name: Lamp

typography.primary: A quiet display serif for the wordmark and headings.
typography.secondary: A neutral grotesque for the session-booking calendar and post-visit summaries.
typography.rationale: Two faces. The serif is the practice; the grotesque is the schedule.
